title: Padding a three-query tester
statement: Given types $\Omega$ and $\beta$, and a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to $\beta$ with three query positions, define a tester with four query positions. It preserves the random seeds and their distribution, uses the original three queries followed by no query, and applies the original acceptance rule to the first three transcript entries.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to $\beta$ with three query positions
